catalog.applies_to: Reka AI as the creator of the Reka Flash and Reka Core model families it trains and announces.

notes: Human origin approval only. It records where Reka AI publishes primary release information; it adds no creator, family, release, product or deployment to the dataset, and it does not make Reka AI a pilot creator.
huggingface.co is an already-trusted generic host reached at https://huggingface.co/RekaAI for the Reka Flash model cards; it is not re-approved here.

source_catalog.trust_notes: Reka AI's official news section; authoritative for its model release announcements. Bounded to /news, the section checked.
source_catalog.verification: Fetched 2026-08-30: /news/reka-flash-3-1-and-reka-quant returned HTTP 200 with the visible article date 'Jul 10, 2025' and the heading 'Reka Flash 3.1 and Reka Quant', on the Reka-owned reka.ai host. It states 'we are excited to open source' the 21-billion-parameter Reka Flash 3.1 under Apache 2.0.

deferred_origins.decision: already-trusted generic host, not re-approved here
deferred_origins.reason: Reached 2026-08-30 for the reka-flash-3.1 model card (HTTP 200). huggingface.co is already a trusted origin through existing dataset sources, so it is noted rather than re-approved.

ambiguities.topic: The visible article date is authoritative, not the page front-matter
ambiguities.note: The reka.ai/news article renders a human-visible date of 'Jul 10, 2025' while the underlying page front-matter carried a later 'published' value from a site rebuild.
ambiguities.guidance: Take the visible article date as the release date and do not use a build/front-matter timestamp that post-dates the announcement.
